description: Merge several Google Maps directions links into one link with all stops in order, to get past the 10-stop limit per route. Short links are expanded. When one route ends where the next starts, the shared stop is kept once.

mergeOverlap.description: Keep a stop shared by the end of one route and the start of the next only once (default true)

items.description: Google Maps directions link, full (google.com/maps/dir/...) or short (maps.app.goo.gl/...)

name: combine_map_links
title: Combine Google Maps links
